applyTo: "docs/**,AGENTS.md,ARCHITECTURE.md,README.md"

# Documentation instructions

- Keep `AGENTS.md` concise; link to deeper docs instead of duplicating them.
- Durable architecture decisions belong in ADRs.
- Temporary sequencing/progress belongs in execution plans.
- When implementation differs from a specification, update the relevant doc in the same change.
- Clearly label intentionally deferred decisions instead of inventing certainty.
- Prefer examples that reflect the actual supplied workbook naming (`AprilTable`, `JuneTable`, `OktTable`, etc.).
